design.mechanism_vs_policy: The loop owns only the obligation: deadline + incident id persisted on entry to decision, a real calendar timer (callback 'agent-loop decision-check'), each rung once per incident, persisted as intended before delivery, one bounded ack (<=15 min, configured responders), one same-key re-raise, resolution by an actual decision. WHO is told and WHEN is config: decision_deadline_s (default 1800, max 86400), decision_ladder (Rung{after_s, seat | exec, ledger, ledger_kind, resolve_cmd}), decision_responders. Claude/ledger/Signal are reached only through the fleet's own notify-claude and escalation-watch, unchanged.
design.delivery_rule: An exec rung with a ledger counts as delivered only when a ledger record with the incident key exists since send-5 s, whatever the rc (notify-claude rc is not delivery proof). Without a ledger, rc 0 is required.
